content.text:
## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: c9fe5296dfa0c1c07a6a1d8a44a554c11485e804

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation approach:** The fix (b594b55) deletes an entire mechanism: the `helpText` cache field in `AbstractCommand`, the `reloadText()` override pattern in `AbstractCommand`/`InvalidCommand`/`OnlinePlayerArgCommand`/`PlayerArgCommand`, and the `CommandParser.reload()`/`Server.reload()` call that triggered it — replacing it with help text computed on-demand via `getHelpText()`. I traced the history of `AbstractCommand.java` and `CommandParser.java` to find where this caching/reload design originated, using `git log -p` across the full range between its introduction and the fix.

**(2) The defect:** Commit `c9fe5296` introduced i18n support and, with it, the `helpText` caching scheme: each `AbstractCommand` subclass computes its `helpText` string once in the constructor and can refresh it later via an overridable `reloadText()`, invoked by `CommandParser.reload()` (called from `Server.loadResources()`). The flaw is that the **constructor duplicates the base class's formatting logic inline instead of delegating to the (overridable) `reloadText()`/`getHelpText()` logic**. For subclasses that override this formatting — `InvalidCommand` (adds `Color.RED`), `OnlinePlayerArgCommand`/`PlayerArgCommand` (append the "(case-insensitive...)" suffix) — the text produced at construction time differs from the text produced after a reload: e.g. `InvalidCommand`'s constructor sets `helpText = t.get(commandCode)` (no color), while only `reloadText()` applies `Color.RED`. Any code path that reads `helpText`/`getHelpText()` before the next `reload()` call sees inconsistent/incorrect (stale or improperly colored/suffixed, or pre-translation) text. This is exactly the class of bug the fix eliminates by removing the cache and computing the string fresh on every call instead of relying on construction-time caching plus a separate, easily-missed reload step.

**(3) Supporting evidence:** I confirmed via `git log -p c9fe529..b594b55 -- AbstractCommand.java CommandParser.java Server.java` that every one of the ~15+ intermediate commits touching these files only performed unrelated refactors (switching from an instance-based `Translations` object to the static `import static simpleserver.lang.Translations.t`, renaming `"\u00a7f"` to `Color.WHITE`, generics changes to `join()`, changing `shouldPassThroughToConsole()`'s signature, adding an `addressFactory`, etc.) — none of them altered the structural cache/reload pattern or the constructor/override asymmetry. `c9fe5296` is a verified ancestor of `b594b55` (`git merge-base --is-ancestor`), and it is the single commit where the removed mechanism (`helpText` field, `reloadText()`, `CommandParser.reload()`, the `commandParser.reload()` call in `Server`) was first added, with the asymmetric logic present from its very first version.

**Uncertainty:** This is a large squashed-feature commit (24+ files, adding full translation support), so it's possible the "bug" being fixed is narrower than what I describe (e.g., only the `InvalidCommand` red-color/translation timing issue specifically), but all the surrounding commits I inspected only carried the flawed design forward without modifying it, so I'm confident `c9fe5296` is where the root cause was introduced rather than any later commit.
